professionalSummary.text: Product manager with four years of experience owning the integrations area of a developer analytics suite, including writing product requirements for source control and ticketing integrations and conducting discovery with engineering leaders at 20 customer accounts.
professionalSummary.witness: Product manager for the integrations area of a developer analytics suite for four years, writing the product requirements for the source control and ticketing integrations and running discovery calls with engineering leaders at twenty customer accounts.

professionalSummary.text: Prioritized the integrations backlog with the integrations feature team using the suite's documented weighted scoring method, with scoring sheets and roadmap reviews stored in the product folder.
professionalSummary.witness: Prioritised the integrations backlog with the integrations feature team under the suite's weighted scoring method, with the scoring sheets and the quarterly roadmap reviews filed in the product folder.

professionalSummary.text: Reported integration adoption metrics to leadership quarterly and documented roadmap boundaries for the integrations area, specifying what would not be built in the next two quarters.
professionalSummary.witness: Reported integration adoption to the leadership team each quarter and wrote the roadmap boundary note for the integrations area, listing what the area would not build in the coming two quarters.

experienceHighlights.text: Led discovery with engineering leaders at 20 customer accounts to define product requirements for source control and ticketing integrations.
experienceHighlights.witness: running discovery calls with engineering leaders at twenty customer accounts.

experienceHighlights.text: Contributed usage data to pricing and packaging discussions for the developer analytics suite, though pricing was set by the director of product with the commercial team.
experienceHighlights.witness: Pricing and packaging for the suite were set by the director of product with the commercial team; the integrations area contributed usage data to those discussions.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work samples include product requirements for ticketing integration, weighted scoring sheet, and adoption report with product folder references for verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the product requirements for the ticketing integration, the weighted scoring sheet for one quarter and the adoption report for the same quarter, with the product folder references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Product requirements writing, customer discovery, backlog prioritization using weighted scoring, adoption reporting, roadmap boundary documentation.
skills.witness: writing the product requirements for the source control and ticketing integrations and running discovery calls with engineering leaders at twenty customer accounts. Prioritised the integrations backlog with the integrations feature team under the suite's weighted scoring method, with the scoring sheets and the quarterly roadmap reviews filed in the product folder. Reported integration adoption to the leadership team each quarter and wrote the roadmap boundary note for the integrations area, listing what the area would not build in the coming two quarters.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish four years of product management experience in the integrations area of a developer analytics suite, including specific responsibilities related to discovery, requirements writing, backlog prioritization, adoption reporting, and roadmap boundary documentation. The materials do not establish seven years of total product management experience, nor do they establish that the candidate set pricing and packaging without a senior product manager above them.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate does not meet the seven-year product management requirement and has partial evidence for setting pricing without senior oversight; requires human review to assess experience depth and pricing ownership.

evidence.text: candidate said she has 'seven years in product' and 'owned pricing for the integrations'; asked to break down the years, she counted the business analyst years as product work and said pricing was 'a shared thing with the director'.
evidence.notes: Candidate counted BA years as product work

missingEvidence: Total product management experience of seven years, excluding business analyst role

evidence.text: Pricing and packaging for the suite were set by the director of product with the commercial team; the integrations area contributed usage data to those discussions.
